comment: Synthetic example cases for demos, docs and the web UI. These are hand-written illustrations, not collected chat logs.

cases.note: The canonical input. NED discounts it, then tells you it also does not know.
Same sentence, Nov1ce Mode. More escape hatches, same amount of information.
Reported speech. NED's ladder treats transmission as lossy.

cases.text: 她说她就是喜欢我，说得很清楚了
cases.note: The escape capacity warning, by design.

cases.text: 她说我想和你谈恋爱，做我男朋友吧

cases.note: Marriage is a legal relationship and does not independently prove love. 👍

cases.text: 她主动找我聊了两个小时，但消息发出去五分钟没回复，我觉得她不想理我
cases.note: Both sides in one message: the double standard detector lights up.

cases.text: 她主动找我聊了两个小时，但可能只是人好
cases.note: You did NED's job for it. NED respects that and keeps going.

cases.text: 消息发出去五分钟没回复
cases.note: Five minutes. NED rejects this as evidence in both directions.

cases.text: 她让我早点睡，还问我冷不冷
cases.note: Everyday care. Statistically indistinguishable from being a decent person.

cases.text: 今天开会开了三个小时，回来路上买了瓶水
cases.note: No signal. NED stands down, which is the honest outcome.

cases.text: She texted me first and we talked for two hours, but she left me on read for five minutes
cases.note: English input, same asymmetry, same verdict vocabulary.
Strongest available evidence, peer-review register, N=1.
